subject: witch_doctor_gris_gris
evidence: When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed.
拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。

context.description_en: Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.  Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.
context.description_zh: 巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每%gold_tick_interval_tooltip%秒会增加1金。右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。

subject: riki_backstab
evidence: Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。

context.description_en: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
context.description_zh: 力丸遁入阴影，变为隐身状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。

subject: death_prophet_witchcraft
evidence: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.
死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。

context.description_en: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.
context.description_zh: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。

subject: life_stealer_infest
evidence: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
驱散类型：弱驱散 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。

context.description_en:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。

shard_loc.en: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。

subject: clinkz_death_pact
evidence: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。

context.description_en: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
context.description_zh: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
notes_en: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
notes_zh: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。

subject: enchantress_enchant
evidence: If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.
如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。

context.description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Illusions can be converted.
notes_zh: 可以转化幻象。

scepter_loc.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

subject: bounty_hunter_jinada
evidence: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
context.description_zh: 赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。

subject: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
evidence: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.
赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
context.description_zh: 赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂眩晕目标。
notes_en: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
notes_zh: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

subject: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally
evidence: Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。

context.description_en: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
context.description_zh: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是%fade_time%秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。

subject: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter
evidence: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game.
如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升%kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%%。

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.
context.description_zh: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升%kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。

subject: bounty_hunter_track
evidence: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying.
If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold.
Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.
追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。

context.description_en: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
context.description_zh: 追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离隐身。
notes_en: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.
notes_zh: 只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。

subject: weaver_time_lapse
evidence: No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.
不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

context.description_en:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes_en: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
notes_zh: 能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

scepter_loc.en: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 时光倒流可以对%abilitycastrange%施法距离内的友方英雄施放。

subject: chen_holy_persuasion
evidence: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty.
陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。

context.description_en: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to %health_min%. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last %unsummon_time% seconds to unsummon it.
context.description_zh: 陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为%health_min%。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在%unsummon_time%秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。
notes_en: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
notes_zh: 如果达到劝化生物的数量上限后再劝化生物，最早劝化的单位将立即死亡。
拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后可以对远古中立生物施放本技能。
升级此技能后在升级前劝化的单位并不会增加生命值。
劝化时单位的魔法恢复至满魔。

shard_loc.en: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.
shard_loc.zh: 神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。

subject: doom_bringer_devour
evidence: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。

context.description_en: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
context.description_zh: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
notes_en: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
notes_zh: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。

shard_loc.en: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

subject: alchemist_goblins_greed
evidence: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes.
With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold.
If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total.
Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。
炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。

context.description_en: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
context.description_zh: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。

scepter_loc.en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
scepter_loc.zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。

subject: alchemist_goblins_greed
evidence: Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。

context.description_en: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
context.description_zh: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。

scepter_loc.en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
scepter_loc.zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。

subject: invoker_sun_strike
evidence: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AOE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECT_KEYBIND

context.description_en: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
context.description_zh: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于火元素等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
notes_en: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
notes_zh: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。

scepter_loc.en: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
scepter_loc.zh: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有%cataclysm_damage_pct%%%伤害。

shard_loc.en: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
shard_loc.zh: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。

subject: lone_druid_spirit_bear
evidence: Spirit Bear cannot gain experience.
熊灵无法获得经验。

context.description_en:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
context.description_zh:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过%bear_attack_leash_range%，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的%backlash_damage%%%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
notes_en: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
notes_zh: 熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有%base_magic_resistance%%%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。

subject: meepo_divided_we_stand
evidence: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo.

context.description_en: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.If any Meepo dies, they all die.
context.description_zh: 米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。

subject: visage_summon_familiars
evidence: Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

context.description_en:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
context.description_zh:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
notes_en: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
notes_zh: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

subject: techies_land_mines
evidence: Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。

context.description_en: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
context.description_zh: 埋布隐形的地雷，不会被真实视域检测到，但是有敌方单位在地雷的%radius%生效范围内会显形。敌人在生效范围内停留超过%proximity_threshold%秒会使地雷爆炸，并且魔法抗性会被暂时降低。爆炸对%min_distance%范围内目标造成全额伤害，对边缘造成的伤害减少至%outer_damage%%%。对建筑物造成%building_damage_pct%%%伤害。
notes_en: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
notes_zh: 感应地雷的%placement_radius%范围内不能再放置地雷。
感应地雷不会阻止中立生物产生。
地雷持续时间没有上限，除非爆炸或被摧毁。
隐形单位也能触发地雷。
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。

subject: snapfire_gobble_up

电炎绝手在小兵被吐出并阵亡后获得相应的金钱。

context.description_en: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to %max_time_in_belly% seconds.
context.description_zh: 小莫迪吞下一个小兵或一名友方英雄，再朝敌人吐出。单位停留在他肚子里最多可达%max_time_in_belly%秒。
notes_en: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.
notes_zh: 电炎绝手在小兵被吐出并阵亡后获得相应的金钱。

subject: helm_of_the_dominator
evidence: Grants the caster 50% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep.
Dominated unit's bounty is set to 100 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.
bounty gold=100.
bounty pct=50.

abilities.title: Dominate
abilities.description:
Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to 370 and max health to a minimum of 1000. Also provides the unit with +25 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen and +4 armor. 

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1000 retain their original max health. Grants the caster 50% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 100 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

context.notes:
Cannot dominate more than one unit at a time. If a new unit is dominated, the old one will die.
Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling Helm of the Dominator will cause dominated units to die.
